sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 260. Deal magic damage (Fire) 5 times that penetrates damage reduction and damage reflection effects with a success value of 100.
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Applies Scorching for 40 seconds with a success value of 100.
-Target: yourself. Applies Rampart for 60 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; [Special] increases all elemental Unison damage Ability Power by 200; [Special] increases success value of all status ailment attacks, including Unison Effects and Ability Effects, by 50; nullifies special debuffs; nullifies debuffs; nullifies Unison gauge reduction. Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects)).
-Applies Wind Inhibitor (prevents wind Unison Attacks and wind Great Spirit Unison Attacks from activating, increases Ability Cost consumption by 100%, and reduces HP recovery effects by 70%) to the enemy Field for 90 seconds.
Fire elemental defense boosted by 200 when equipped in the Main Slot.
